messages:
jade: Heads up — bumped @redwood/inference-js 2.1.x -> 2.2.0 and our edge widgets grew ~500KB. Vercel Edge cold starts fail with "initRuntime is not defined".

omar: Oof. Which bundler? Any default imports?

jade: Vite (esbuild) + Rollup for production. We had a tiny helper doing `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`. Replacing with `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` changed failure mode but bundle still huge. Analyzer shows `dist/cjs` code in final bundle.

lina: Sounds like two issues: 1) the package is published with `sideEffects: false` while also providing a small runtime/boot module that mutates globals; bundlers can drop it. 2) the ESM build appears to re-export CJS default via an interop shim, which pulls the entire CJS output into ESM consumers.

jade: i inspected node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/package.json in 2.2.0 — it has `main: dist/cjs/index.js`, `module: dist/esm/index.js`, `sideEffects: false`, and an `exports` entry for a `./boot` path pointing at dist/esm/boot.js and dist/cjs/boot.js.

omar: the `sideEffects: false` at package root is fine only if you list side-effect files in an array. Otherwise bundlers might tree-shake the boot file away. That explains missing initRuntime. The CJS interop shim explains the bundle bloat.

michael: Consumer workaround that worked for one of our apps: explicitly import the boot file early `import '@redwood/inference-js/boot'` to force it into the bundle, and prefer direct ESM subpath imports where possible. Ugly but effective until SDK fix.

lina: downside: `import '@redwood/inference-js/boot'` is fragile across versions and breaks DX. Also TypeScript resolution can fail in monorepos when people import deep paths like `@redwood/inference-js/esm`.

jade: i tried the boot import — fixes runtime but TS complains in our monorepo. Pinning to 2.1.x is our short-term mitigation.

build-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-6010: "js-sdk: sideEffects + cjs interop causes edge boot omission and bundle bloat" assigned to eng-devex. Repro: tiny Vite app attached.

michael: Action items for SDK maintainers: (1) remove `sideEffects: false` or add `./dist/esm/boot.js` to the sideEffects allowlist, (2) publish a clean ESM entry that doesn't re-export CJS via inline shims, (3) make runtime init explicit (export initBoot()) and document it, (4) add integration tests: vite/esbuild/webpack + node/edge + TS monorepo resolution.

doc-bot: Adding a short troubleshooting snippet to the SDK upgrade guide: recommend pin to 2.1.x, show `import '@redwood/inference-js/boot'` workaround, and note caveats for TS path mapping.

jade: thanks — will keep pinned and follow DEVEX-6010. please ping if someone lands an SDK patch. :thumbsup:
